source_note: FanGraphs (Feb 24 2026) overall free-agent $/WAR for the 2025-26 class ($11.23M; $12.84M for 2+ WAR tier). CBA expires December 2026 so 2027+ economics are assumptions.

Realized growth since 2017 is lower under FanGraphs' newer method so this is generous; ASSUMPTION for 2027+ (CBA expires December 2026).

ASSUMPTION: 2027+ minimum = 2026 minimum grown at the $/WAR inflation rate (no 2027+ schedule exists; CBA expires December 2026 so 2027+ economics are assumptions). Also used backwards for the backtest-era approximation.
